::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 31 1894  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 212
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
I shall be very happy to receive [£50](organizations/other_160.qmd)for the American copyright of [‘A Long Vacation’](cmy_books/cmybook_237.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Endorsed 'Brett has agreed to pay £60 vide his letter of Dec 24/94'.
